accepted_scope: For every integer d>=2, some connected open quasi-conical tower with inductively chosen expanding cube widths and positive shrinking zero-thickness windows has a form-defined Dirichlet Laplacian with a complete orthonormal eigenbasis, spectrum=essential spectrum=[0,infinity), dense positive eigenvalues, no zero eigenfunction, and no absolutely or singular continuous spectral subspace.
priority_summary: No full matching predecessor was located in bounded primary-source, author/citation and directZenodo searches. The contribution is the exhaustive geometric construction and complete-eigenbasis/noSC conclusion beyond the inspected KL/HSS endpoints. KL geometry, future-width freedom, finite-window convergence, one/finite embedded eigenvalues and noAC, plus older spectral-family/multiplicity machinery, are substantive antecedents. Abstract finite-rank reducing-space diagonalization is standard. Historical first priority and current worldwide openness are not certified. Older RT1975/Witsch1990/Post bodies and a restricted finite-dimensional gap-note body remain uninspected limits.
mandatory_global_framing: State complete existential theorem for every integer d>=2, choosing both growing widths and positive shrinking zero-thickness windows.
Credit KL Sections2.2,3,5 and Remark3.1, and HSS Proposition1.4 and related Neumann decoupling; no invention of geometry, cluster machinery or abstract finite-rank criterion.
Describe the additional exhaustive geometric transport and basis completeness; no inference from noAC or dense eigenvalues alone.
Answer the precise dated OWR/KL existential question; no first, sole, certified current-worldwide-open or arbitrary preassigned-width claim.
No smooth-boundary, Neumann, positive-length-passage or effective-aperture extension.
Disclose bounded search, inaccessible older/restricted bodies and unindexed/nonpublic coverage limits.
Preserve spectral-family source-reading correction in its separate addendum; both survey formulas have closure bars.
Extensive AI use, unrefereed, no external human peer review or formal proof certification.
